title: The Euler-liar subgroup is proper
statement: Let $N$ be a nonzero natural number with $1<N$, assume that $N$ is odd and not prime. Then the subgroup of units modulo $N$ whose Jacobi symbol equals their $(N-1)/2$-th power is a proper subgroup of the units modulo $N$.
